cleavage_agent.evidence: MF were predigested for 3 h with endoproteinase Lys-C (0.5 µg µl-1; Wako Chemicals) at room temperature.
samples were digested with 3 µl sequencing-grade modified trypsin (0.5 µg µl-1; Promega) overnight at 37 °C.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphopeptides were enriched over titanium dioxide (TiO2) (GL Sciences).

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were eluted from a 75 µm homemade 25 cm analytical column on a linear gradient running from 5 to 95% acetonitrile over 135 min and sprayed directly into the mass spectrometer.

reduction_concentration.evidence: 1 g of roots (fresh weight) was homogenized in 10 ml extraction buffer (330mM mannitol, 100 mM KCl, 1 mM EDTA, 50 mM Tris-MES, fresh 5 mM DTT, and 1 mM phenylmethylsulfonylfluoride, pH 7.5) in the presence of 0.5% v/v proteinase inhibitor mixture (MedChemExpress) and phosphatase inhibitors (25 mM NaF, 1 mM Na3VO4, 1 mM benzamidin, 3 µM leupeptin) in Dounce homogenizers.
